style_when: the article explains how a system, process or stack actually works — money flows, supply chains, pipelines, an agent assembly line
prompt: clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. An asymmetric composition showing an enterprise server pipeline laid over a tactile brushed steel workbench. On the left, a dense, heavy block of locked server racks and frosted copper tubing. A sharp physical partition divides it from the right, where an open, modular tray holds loose, shifting server blades. Flat muted palette with one sharp amber accent colour highlighting the dividing partition. Thin consistent line weight, one directional light throwing long cast shadows across the textured steel, generous empty margin, editorial restraint.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, wordmarks, watermarks, labels, logos, UI, bare geometric shapes
rationale: A technical isometric cutaway perfectly maps the systemic structural division of an AI prompt into a fixed 'frozen head' and a dynamic tail, visualizing the invisible software boundary as physical hardware.
subject: an isometric server pipeline with a locked static block and an open modular tray
alt_text: Isometric cutaway of a server pipeline showing a heavy locked block of static racks partitioned from loose shifting blades.
caption: The financial efficiency of an AI agent depends entirely on where developers place the boundary between fixed instructions and dynamic inputs.
title: AI Prompt Caching Economics
